name: borrow_raw
declaration: const unsafe fn borrow_raw (fd : RawFd) -> Self
documentation:
Returns a `BorrowedFd` holding the given raw file descriptor.

 # Safety

 The resource pointed to by `fd` must remain open for the duration of
 the returned `BorrowedFd`, and it must not have the value
 `SOLID_NET_INVALID_FD`.
rules: The resource pointed to by `fd` must remain open for the lifetime of the returned `BorrowedFd`.
